item.title: People Power Party: "President Lee Leaving Voting Booth with Ballot Paper Violates Election Law"… Files Complaint with Police (국힘 “이 대통령, 투표용지 들고 기표소 나온 건 선거법 위반”…경찰 고발)
item.description:
The People Power Party (PPP) on the 30th filed a complaint against President Lee Jae-myung for alleged violation of the Public Official Election Act. The party argued that President Lee, during early voting the previous day, left the voting booth holding his ballot paper and then re-entered, violating the secret ballot rule. The Democratic Party of Korea dismissed this as a "simple incident." (국민의힘이 30일 이재명 대통령을 공직선거법 위반 혐의로 고발했다. 전날 이 대통령이 사전투표 과정에서 투표용지를 들고 기표소에 나왔다가 들어간 점이 비밀투표 규정을 위반했다는 것이다. 더불어민주당은 “단순한 해프닝”이라고 일축했다.)

PPP leadership, including floor leader Jang Dong-hyuk and Secretary-General Jeong Hee-yong, visited the Seoul Metropolitan Police Agency in Jongno-gu, Seoul, on the afternoon of that day to submit the complaint against President Lee. Jang stated, "The president coming out of the voting booth holding a marked ballot paper is a clear violation of the Public Official Election Act. Investigative authorities must thoroughly examine the facts and handle the matter strictly in accordance with the law and principles." Earlier that morning, during a campaign rally in Chuncheon, Gangwon Province, Jang escalated criticism, saying, "Didn't the president openly engage in electioneering in front of broadcast cameras? Violating election neutrality is clearly a reason for impeachment." (장동혁 대표와 정희용 사무총장 등 국민의힘 지도부는 이날 오후 서울 종로구 서울경찰청을 찾아 이 대통령에 대한 고발장을 제출했다. 장 대표는 “대통령이 기표를 한 투표지를 들고 기표소 밖으로 나온 것은 공직선거법을 명백하게 위반한 행위”라며 “수사기관은 사실관계를 철저히 조사하고 법과 원칙에 따라 엄정하게 처리해야 한다”고 말했다. 장 대표는 이날 오전 강원 춘천 유세에서는 “대통령이 대놓고 방송 카메라 앞에서 선거운동을 한 것 아닌가. 선거중립 위반은 명백한 탄핵 사유”라고 비판 수위를 높였다.)

On the 29th, President Lee received a ballot paper at an out-of-district polling station at the Samcheong-dong Community Center in Jongno-gu, Seoul, entered the voting booth, then came out holding the ballot paper and asked, "Is it okay if only half is stamped? Wouldn't it be invalid?" before completing his vote. The PPP claimed that the ballot paper was exposed during this process, describing it as "blatant election interference," and continued criticism by visiting the National Election Commission on the 30th to file a protest. (이 대통령은 29일 서울 종로구 삼청동 주민센터 관외투표소에서 투표용지를 받아 기표소에 들어간 뒤 투표용지를 들고 나와 “반만 찍혀도 괜찮냐. 무효가 되지 않냐”고 물은 뒤 다시 투표를 마쳤다. 국민의힘은 이 과정에서 투표용지가 노출됐다며 “명백한 선거개입”으로 규정하고 30일 중앙선거관리위원회를 항의 방문하는 등 비판을 이어가고 있다.)

The Democratic Party countered, saying it was "not worth responding to." Democratic Party Senior Spokesperson Kang Joon-hyun told reporters, "It's understandable to feel anxious about a vague stamp and ask a question," adding, "The PPP is launching a groundless attack using various extreme expressions, but we don't see it as worth responding to." Senior Deputy Spokesperson Lim Se-eun said in a comment, "The Election Commission has already clearly stated that there is no legal issue at all," and "Exaggerating a problem that doesn't exist to mislead the public is itself irresponsible politics." (민주당은 “대응할 가치가 없다”고 받아쳤다. 강준현 민주당 수석대변인은 이날 기자들과 만나 “(도장이) 애매하게 찍히면 불안하니 물어볼 수 있다”며 “국민의힘에서 여러가지 과격한 표현을 써가며 억지 공격 중인데 대응할 가치를 못 느낀다”고 말했다. 임세은 선임부대변인은 논평을 통해 “선관위는 이미 법적으로도 아무런 문제가 없다고 명확히 밝혔다”며 “존재하지 않는 문제를 부풀려 국민을 호도하는 것이야말로 무책임한 정치”라고 했다.)

Reporter Yoo Young-jae young@hani.co.kr (유영재 기자 young@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Han Dong-hoon "Difference in Attitude Toward the Public" Ha Jung-woo "Answer About the Assault on Residents"… SNS War of Words (한동훈 “국민 대하는 태도 차이” 하정우 “주민 폭행 답하라”…SNS 설전)
item.description:
On the 30th, four days before the June 3rd local elections and by-elections for National Assembly members, Han Dong-hoon, independent candidate for Busan North Gap, and Ha Jung-woo, candidate for the Democratic Party of Korea, engaged in a sharp exchange of words on social media. (6·3 지방선거와 국회의원 재보궐선거를 4일 앞둔 30일, 한동훈 부산 북갑 무소속 후보와 하정우 더불어민주당 후보가 사회관계망서비스(SNS)에서 날 선 신경전을 펼쳤다.)

Candidate Han posted a video titled "Difference in Attitude Toward the Public" on Facebook that day. In the video, Candidate Ha is seen saying to a man on the street, "Again, again, again, again, again. You need to give me time to explain, don't you?" When the man said, "I'm an NHN shareholder," demanding an explanation related to Upstage, Candidate Ha responded, "You can't even distinguish it from NHN. What's this? It's been over 10 years since they were separated." (한 후보는 이날 페이스북에 ‘국민을 대하는 태도 차이’라는 제목의 영상을 올렸다. 이 영상에서 하 후보는 길거리에서 한 남성을 향해 “또 또 또 또 또. 시간을 줘야 해명할 것 아닙니까”라고 말했다. 그 남성이 “저는 엔에이치엔(NHN) 주주인데”라며 업스테이지 관련 해명을 요구하자, 하 후보는 “엔에이치엔이랑 구분도 못 하시면서 무슨. 분리된 지가 10년이 넘었다”고 반응했다.)

In the latter part of the video, Candidate Han showed himself folding his hands and appearing to listen attentively even when confronted by a woman shouting, "Is Buk-gu your meal ticket?" thereby comparing himself with Candidate Ha. (한 후보는 영상 뒷부분에 “북구가 니 밥이가”라고 외치는 여성과 맞닥뜨리고도 두 손을 모으고 경청하는 듯한 자신의 모습을 담으며 하 후보와 자신을 비교했다.)

In response, Candidate Ha posted a piece titled "Buk-gu Resident Assault Incident, Candidate Han Dong-hoon, Answer Now" on Facebook. The video uploaded by Candidate Ha showed the man from Candidate Han's video, while mentioning NHN, saying "Don't push me" to another citizen and appearing to shove him. (그러자 하 후보는 페이스북에 ‘북구 주민 폭행사태, 한동훈 후보가 답하십시오’라는 제목의 게시물을 올렸다. 하 후보가 올린 영상에는 한 후보가 올린 영상 속 남성이 엔에이치엔 관련 언급 도중 다른 시민에게 “밀지 말라고”라고 말하며 밀치는 듯한 모습이 담겼다.)

Candidate Ha said, "Yesterday, on Deokcheon Youth Street, a shocking incident occurred where a YouTuber supporting Candidate Han used violence against a Buk-gu resident," and asked, "Is the YouTuber who used violence the 'volunteer' that Candidate Han praised?" Candidate Ha added, "Manage your fan club thoroughly. We absolutely refuse the 'pop-up store' style of politics in our Buk-gu." (하 후보는 “어제 덕천 젊음의 거리에서 한 후보 측 지지 유튜버가 북구 주민에게 폭력을 행사하는 충격적인 일이 발생했다”며 “폭력을 행사한 유튜버가 한 후보가 치켜세우던 ‘자원봉사자’입니까”라고 물었다. 이어 하 후보는 “팬클럽 관리부터 철저히 하라. 우리 북구에 떴다방식 정치는 절대 사절”이라고 덧붙였다.)

Reporter Yoo Young-jae young@hani.co.kr (유영재 기자 young@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Final Early Voting Rate for Local Elections at 23.51%, All-Time High… Jeonnam Highest, Daegu Lowest (지방선거 최종 사전투표율 23.51%, 역대 최고치…전남 최고, 대구 최저)
item.description:
The final early voting rate for the June 3 local elections has been tallied at 23.51%. This is 2.89 percentage points higher than the previous record for local elections, which stood at 20.62% in 2022. The final early voting rate for the National Assembly by-elections held concurrently with the local elections was recorded at 24.12%. (6·3 지방선거 최종 사전투표율이 23.51%로 집계됐다. 역대 지방선거 최고 사전투표율이었던 2022년 20.62%보다 2.89%포인트 높은 수치다. 지방선거와 함게 치러지는 국회의원 재보궐선거 최종 사전투표율은 24.12%로 집계됐다.)

The National Election Commission announced that out of a total of 44,649,908 eligible voters, 10,498,411 cast their ballots during the two-day early voting period, which ran from 6 a.m. on the 29th to 6 p.m. on the following day. After setting a record for the highest first-day early voting rate in local election history at 11.6% the previous day, the rate broke records again on the second day. The final early voting rates for the 2014 and 2018 local elections, when early voting was first introduced, were 11.48% and 20.14%, respectively. The early voting rates for the 21st presidential election last year and the 22nd general election in 2024 were 34.74% and 31.28%, respectively. (중앙선거관리위원회는 지난 29일 아침 6시부터 이날 오후 6시까지 이틀간 진행된 사전투표에 전체 유권자 4464만9908명 중 1049만8411명이 투표했다고 밝혔다. 전날도 역대 지방선거 첫날 최고 사전투표율(11.6%)을 기록한 데 이어 이틀째에도 기록을 갈아치웠다. 사전투표가 처음 시작된 2014년 지방선거와 2018년 지방선거의 최종 사전투표율은 각각 11.48%, 20.14%였다. 지난해 제21대 대선 사전투표율은 34.74%, 2024년 제22대 총선 사전투표율은 31.28%였다.)

By region, the highest early voting rate was in South Jeolla Province (38.95%), followed by North Jeolla Province (35.05%) and Gwangju (27.83%). The lowest early voting rate was in Daegu (18.65%), followed by Gyeonggi Province (20.96%) and Busan (21.29%). Seoul's voting rate was 23.84%. (지역별로 살펴보면 사전투표율이 가장 높은 곳은 전남(38.95%)이었고, 전북(35.05%)과 광주(27.83%)가 뒤를 이었다. 사전투표율이 가장 낮은 곳은 대구(18.65%)였고 경기(20.96%) 부산(21.29%)가 뒤따랐다. 서울 투표율은 23.84%였다.)

Looking at the early voting rates for National Assembly by-elections by region, Busan's Buk-gu district—where candidates including Ha Jeong-woo of the Democratic Party, Park Min-sik of the People Power Party, and independent Han Dong-hoon are competing—recorded a rate of 25.57%, exceeding the overall average early voting rate across all 14 constituencies. The early voting rate for Gyeonggi's Pyeongtaek-eul district, a five-way race drawing significant attention, was 18.39%, making it the third lowest after Daegu Dalseong (17.56%) and South Chungcheong's Asan-eul (18.24%). (국회의원 재보궐선거 사전투표율을 지역별로 보면, 하정우 더불어민주당·박민식 국민의힘·한동훈 무소속 후보 등이 맞붙는 부산 북갑은 25.57%로 전체 14개 지역구 합계 사전투표율을 웃돌았다. 5파전으로 치러져 이목이 쏠리는 경기 평택을의 사전투표율은 18.39%로 대구 달성(17.56%), 충남 아산을(18.24%)에 이어 세번째로 낮았다.)

On the main voting day, June 3, voters can only cast ballots at polling stations corresponding to their registered residential addresses. Most voters nationwide will receive seven ballots, but voters in areas holding National Assembly by-elections will receive eight ballots. (6월3일 본투표 때는 주민등록 주소지 관할투표소에서만 투표할 수 있다. 전국 대부분 유권자들은 7장의 투표용지를 받지만, 국회의원 재보궐선거가 열리는 지역의 유권자들은 8장의 투표용지를 받는다.)

Reporter Yoo Young-jae young@hani.co.kr (유영재 기자 young@hani.co.kr)

item.title: President Lee: "Abstaining from voting gives opportunities to those who deceive the people" (이 대통령 “투표 포기는 국민 속이는 자들에게 기회 주는 것”)
item.description:
President Lee Jae-myung said on the 31st, "I urge you to actively participate in voting to clearly show that the people are the masters of this country, where power must be directed, and where the will of the sovereign lies." (이재명 대통령이 31일 “투표에 적극 참여해 이 나라의 주인은 국민이라는 사실을, 권력은 어디를 향해야 하는지를, 주권자의 뜻이 어디에 있는지를 분명히 보여달라”고 말했다.)

President Lee stated on X (formerly Twitter) on the same day, "In a democratic republic, the silence of the sovereign and abstention from voting give opportunities to those who deceive the people, abuse power for private gain, and ruin the lives of me and my family." He then cited Plato's words: "The price of political indifference is being ruled by the worst kinds of people." (이 대통령은 이날 엑스(X·옛 트위터)에 “민주공화국에서 주권자의 침묵과 투표포기는 국민을 속이고 사익을 위해 권력을 남용하며 나와 가족의 삶을 망치는 자들에게 기회를 주는 것”이라고 말했다. 그러면서 플라톤의 “정치무관심의 대가는 최악의 저질들에게 지배당하는 것”이라는 말을 인용했다.)

President Lee emphasized, "I ask you to find loyal and capable individuals who will use the power entrusted by the people solely according to their will and for the people, and give them opportunities. Depending on how elected officials work with what mindset and attitude, the world can become either hell or heaven." (이 대통령은 “국민이 맡긴 권력을 오로지 국민의 뜻에 따라 국민만을 위해 사용할, 충직하고 유능한 이들을 찾아 그들에게 기회를 주시기 바란다”며 “선출된 공직자가 어떤 마음과 자세로 어떻게 하느냐에 따라 세상은 지옥이 될 수도 천국이 될 수도 있다”고 강조했다.)

President Lee strongly encouraged voting in the June 3 local elections. He said, "The power of voting is stronger than you think. Whether those elected become loyal servants who enrich my life or malignant rulers who destroy the world and inflict pain on the people depends on the hands of the sovereign." He added, "If there are politicians or political groups uncomfortable with this statement, they are the entrenched vested interests that the sovereign must overcome through voting." (이 대통령은 6·3 지방선거 투표를 적극 독려했다. 이 대통령은 “투표의 힘은 생각보다 강하다”며 “선출된 그들이 내 삶을 풍요롭게 만드는 충직한 머슴이 될 지, 세상을 파괴하고 국민에게 고통을 주는 악성 지배자가 될 지는 주권자의 손에 달려 있다”고 말했다. 이 대통령은 이어 “이 말이 불편한 정치인이나 정치집단이 있다면 그들이 바로 주권자가 투표로서 극복해야 할 구태 기득권자들”이라고 덧붙였다.)

President Lee and First Lady Kim Hye-kyung cast their votes on the first day of early voting, the 29th, at the Samcheong-dong Community Center near the presidential office. The early voting for the June 3 local elections, held over two days on the 29th and 30th, recorded a turnout of 23.51%, the highest for local elections. This is 2.89 percentage points higher than the previous record for local elections, which was 20.62% in the 8th local elections in 2022. (이 대통령은 김혜경 여사와 사전투표 첫날인 지난 29일 청와대 인근 삼청동 주민센터에서 투표를 마쳤다. 29~30일 이틀간 이뤄진 6·3 지방선거 사전투표가 지방선거 기준으로는 최고치인 23.51%의 투표율을 기록했다. 이는 역대 지방선거 종전 최고치인 2022년 제8회 지방선거 사전투표율(20.62%)과 비교해도 2.89%포인트 높은 수치다.)

Reporter Seo Young-ji yj@hani.co.kr (서영지 기자 yj@hani.co.kr)

item.title: People from Daegu and Gyeongbuk Living in Seoul Stir Regional Sentiment to Protect Their Privileges (대구 경북 출신 ‘서울사람들’ 기득권 지키려 지역감정 자극)
item.description:
Where do you think the most important place is in the June 3 local elections and National Assembly by-elections? Probably, it is 'where I live.' Because we must elect the heads of our local districts and local council members who will work for the next four years. (여러분은 6·3 지방선거 및 국회의원 재보궐선거에서 가장 중요한 곳이 어디라고 생각하십니까? 아마도 ‘내가 사는 곳’일 것입니다. 앞으로 4년 동안 일할 우리 동네 단체장과 지방의원을 잘 뽑아야 하기 때문입니다.)

Then, where is the most politically significant place? It may vary depending on one's perspective on politics. Some might point to the Seoul mayoral election. Seoul is the capital of South Korea. Its symbolic importance is immense. Others might point to Buk-gu, Busan. Because the outcome for Han Dong-hoon, former leader of the People Power Party, could become a catalyst for the realignment of conservative forces. Still others might point to the Jeollabuk-do gubernatorial election. Because it is related to the internal power struggle within the ruling party that will unfold after the election. (그렇다면 정치적으로 가장 큰 의미가 있는 곳은 어디일까요? 정치를 바라보는 시각에 따라서 엇갈릴 수 있습니다. 서울시장을 꼽는 분들이 있을 것입니다. 서울은 대한민국 수도입니다. 상징성이 큽니다. 부산 북갑을 꼽는 분들도 있을 것입니다. 한동훈 전 국민의힘 대표 당락에 따라 보수 세력 재편의 계기가 될 수 있기 때문입니다. 전북지사 선거를 꼽는 분들도 있을 것입니다. 선거 이후 벌어질 여권 내부 권력투쟁과 관련이 있기 때문입니다.)

I believe the Daegu mayoral election holds the greatest political significance. Why? Because it is a golden opportunity for Daegu to break free from the hostage situation of regional conflict. It is also the last chance to revitalize Daegu's economy. (저는 대구시장 선거가 가장 큰 정치적 의미가 있다고 생각합니다. 왜냐구요? 대구가 지역갈등의 인질에서 풀려날 절호의 기회이기 때문입니다. 대구의 경제를 살릴 마지막 기회이기 때문입니다.)

In our country, Daegu and Gyeongbuk are where hegemonic regionalism began. Park Chung-hee, a native of Gumi, Gyeongbuk who graduated from Daegu Normal School, came to power by suspending the constitutional order through the May 16 military coup in 1961. People from Daegu and Gyeongbuk began to enter the core networks of Korean politics, bureaucracy, and business. (우리나라에서 대구 경북은 패권적 지역주의가 시작된 곳입니다. 경북 구미 출신으로 대구사범학교를 나온 박정희 소장이 1961년 5·16 쿠데타로 헌정을 중단시키고 집권했습니다. 대구 경북 출신들이 우리나라 정치, 관료, 재계의 중심 인맥으로 진입하기 시작했습니다.)

After the new military group led by Security Commander Chun Doo-hwan suspended the constitution through the May 18 coup in 1980 and took power, the TK faction went even further. The presidencies of Chun Doo-hwan and Roh Tae-woo were the 'heyday of TK.' Key positions in the military, prosecution, and administrative branches were occupied by people from Daegu and Gyeongbuk. Anyone with influence in Daegu could, through school ties or regional connections, reach the core of power within a few steps. They easily handled various personnel matters and favor-seeking requests. (전두환 보안사령관 중심의 신군부가 1980년 5·18 쿠데타로 헌정을 중단시키고 집권한 뒤 티케이들은 한술 더 떴습니다. 전두환 노태우 대통령 시절은 ‘티케이 전성시대’였습니다. 군, 검찰, 행정부 요직을 대구 경북 출신들이 장악했습니다. 대구에서 힘을 좀 쓰는 사람들은 학연, 지연으로 한 두 다리 건너면 누구나 권력 핵심부에 선이 닿았습니다. 각종 인사와 청탁 민원을 손쉽게 처리했습니다.)

During the 15-year presidencies of Kim Young-sam, Kim Dae-jung, and Roh Moo-hyun, Daegu and Gyeongbuk struggled under a 'power withdrawal syndrome,' but they enjoyed another heyday during the 10-year presidencies of Lee Myung-bak and Park Geun-hye. Since then, under Presidents Moon Jae-in, Yoon Suk-yeol, and Lee Jae-myung, the region has again moved away from power. Although President Lee Jae-myung is originally from Andong, Gyeongbuk, he is not considered a TK figure because he moved to Seongnam, Gyeonggi Province as a child and did not attend middle or high school in Daegu or Gyeongbuk. (김영삼 김대중 노무현 대통령 15년 동안 대구 경북은 권력 금단현상으로 힘들었지만, 이명박 박근혜 대통령 10년 동안 다시 전성기를 맞았습니다. 그 뒤 문재인 윤석열 이재명 대통령 때는 다시 권력에서 멀어져 오늘에 이르고 있습니다. 이재명 대통령은 경북 안동 출신이지만 티케이가 아닙니다. 어린 시절 경기도 성남으로 떠났고 대구 경북에서 중고등학교에 다니지도 않았기 때문입니다.)

To protect their vested interests, the TK faction discriminated against and excluded other regions. They particularly made Honam a scapegoat. Through the 1987 presidential election, the 1990 merger of three parties, the 1992 general election, the 1995 local elections, the 1996 general election, the 2000 general election, and the 2002 presidential election, the hegemonic regionalism centered on TK constantly clashed with the defensive regionalism of Honam and Chungcheong. (티케이들은 자신들의 기득권을 지키기 위해 다른 지역을 차별하고 배제했습니다. 특히 호남을 희생양으로 삼았습니다. 1987년 대통령 선거, 1990년 3당 합당, 1992년 총선, 1995년 지방선거, 1996년 총선, 2000년 총선, 2002년 대선 등을 거치며 티케이 중심의 패권적 지역주의와 호남 및 충청의 방어적 지역주의가 끊임없이 충돌했습니다.)

Voters in Daegu and Gyeongbuk have also given overwhelming support to politicians not from Daegu or Gyeongbuk, such as Kim Young-sam, Lee Hoe-chang, and Yoon Suk-yeol, simply because they were conservatives. The same applied to general elections for the National Assembly and local elections. They voted blindly for the Grand National Party, the Saenuri Party, the Liberty Korea Party, the Future United Party, and the People Power Party. In this way, Daegu earned the honor of being called the 'heart of conservatism.' (대구 경북 유권자들은 김영삼 이회창 윤석열 등 대구 경북 출신이 아닌 정치인들에게도 압도적 지지를 보냈습니다. 그들이 보수라는 이유였습니다. 국회의원 총선거와 지방선거도 마찬가지였습니다. 한나라당-새누리당-자유한국당-미래통합당-국민의힘에 묻지 마 투표를 했습니다. 대구는 이렇게 해서 ‘보수의 심장’이라는 명예를 얻었습니다.)

During the TK heyday, voters in Daegu and Gyeongbuk took pride in being close to the powerful. During the era of being the 'heart of conservatism,' they took pride in upholding conservatism. However, it has become increasingly difficult for Daegu and Gyeongbuk to make a living. The region has degenerated into a place that is increasingly hard to live in. (티케이 전성시대에 대구 경북 유권자들은 권력자들과 가깝다는 자긍심이 있었습니다. 보수의 심장 시절에는 보수를 지킨다는 자부심이 있었습니다. 그러나 대구 경북은 먹고 살기가 점점 더 힘들어졌습니다. 점점 더 살기 어려운 동네로 추락했습니다.)

On May 15, the Daegu Policy Research Institute published 'Daegu Policy Brief' Issue No. 34 (Titled: 9th Term of Popularly Elected Officials: Strategies Needed for Daegu's Economic Rebound through Recovery of Construction Industry and Expansion of Tax Base). The subtitle reads: "The sluggish local construction industry and contraction of the real estate market are the main causes of the recent decline in Daegu's Gross Regional Domestic Product (GRDP)." It contains these shocking facts: (대구정책연구원이 5월15일 ‘대구정책브리프’ 34호(민선 9기, 건설경기 회복과 세수 기반 확충을 통한 대구 경제 반등 전략 필요)를 발간했습니다. “지역 건설업 부진과 부동산 경기 위축이 최근 대구 지역내총생산 하락의 주요 원인”이라는 부제가 붙어 있습니다. 이런 충격적 내용이 들어 있습니다.)

"In 1985, Daegu's GRDP accounted for 5.2% of the national total, but this shrank to 2.9% in 2024." (“1985년 대구 지역내총생산(GRDP)은 전국 대비 5.2% 비중을 차지했으나, 2024년 2.9%로 축소”)

"Daegu's per capita GRDP has been the lowest in the nation since 1993." (“대구 1인당 지역내총생산은 1993년부터 전국 최하위 수준”)

"Ranked 10th out of 13 cities/provinces in 1985, 15th out of 15 in 1993, and 17th out of 17 in 2024." (“1985년 13개 시도 중 10위, 1993년 15개 시도 중 15위, 2024년 17개 시도 중 17위”)

"In 1985, Daegu's per capita GRDP was 83.2% of the national average, but it contracted to 63.4% in 2024." (“1985년 대구 1인당 지역내총생산은 전국 대비 83.2% 수준이었으나, 2024년 63.4%로 축소”)

Isn't something strange? The TK faction held power for so long, so why is it getting harder to live in Daegu? There's another strange thing. I mentioned earlier that the TK faction discriminated against and excluded other regions to protect their vested interests. However, people living in Daegu and Gyeongbuk are not actually exclusive towards people from other regions. How did this happen? (뭔가 좀 이상하지 않습니까? 티케이들이 그렇게 오랫동안 권력을 잡았는데도 대구는 왜 점점 더 살기가 어려워지는 것일까요? 이상한 건 또 있습니다. 제가 앞에서 티케이들이 기득권을 지키기 위해 다른 지역을 차별하고 배제했다고 말씀드렸습니다. 그러나 실제로 대구와 경북에 사는 사람들은 다른 지역 출신들에게 배타적이지 않습니다. 이게 도대체 어찌 된 일일까요?)

The secret lies in the true identity of the so-called 'TK.' The TK faction's hometowns may be Daegu and Gyeongbuk, but strictly speaking, they are not people of Daegu and Gyeongbuk. They are 'people from Daegu and Gyeongbuk who live in Seoul,' using hegemonic regionalism for their own advancement. Their homes are usually in Gangnam, Seoul. (비밀은 이른바 ‘티케이’의 정체입니다. 티케이들은 고향이 대구 경북일 뿐 엄밀히 말하면 대구 경북 사람들이 아닙니다. 패권적 지역주의를 자신의 출세에 이용하는 ‘대구 경북 출신 서울 사람들’입니다. 집도 대개 서울 강남에 있습니다.)

For them, their own power and wealth are paramount. They have little interest in how their hometown people make a living. They stir up regional sentiment in Daegu and Gyeongbuk to use for their own advancement. They have been the main culprits behind the regional extinction caused by the concentration of power in the Seoul metropolitan area over the past decades. It is because of the TK faction that Daegu and Gyeongbuk have fallen on hard times. (이들에게는 자신의 권력과 재산이 가장 중요합니다. 고향 사람들이 먹고사는 데 별 관심이 없습니다. 대구 경북의 지역감정을 자극해서 자신의 출세에 이용합니다. 지난 수십년간 수도권 집중으로 지방 소멸을 가져온 주범이 바로 이들입니다. 티케이들 때문에 대구 경북이 못살게 된 것입니다.)

It was precisely at this point that Democratic Party candidate Kim Bu-kyum targeted his campaign. In his declaration of candidacy on March 30, candidate Kim Bu-kyum said: (바로 이 지점을 김부겸 더불어민주당 후보가 파고들었습니다. 김부겸 후보는 3월30일 출마선언에서 이런 말을 했습니다.)

“Today, I aim to overcome a wall higher than regionalism: the wall of despair called regional extinction. Our sons and daughters are leaving Daegu. There are no proper jobs. When I was growing up, Daegu was my pride. Shouldn't we let our sons and daughters feel that pride too? Overcoming regionalism and achieving balanced regional development is my final calling. Together with the citizens of Daegu, I will find hope for Daegu's future.” (“오늘 저는 지역주의보다 더 높은 벽을 넘고자 합니다. 지역소멸이라는 절망의 벽입니다. 우리 아들딸들이 대구를 등지고 있습니다. 제대로 된 일자리가 없습니다. 제가 클 때 대구는 제 자부심이었습니다. 그 자부심을 우리 아들딸들도 느끼게 해줘야 하지 않겠습니까? 지역주의 극복과 지역 균형발전이 제 마지막 소명입니다. 대구 시민과 함께 대구의 미래 희망을 찾겠습니다.”)

On May 28, he posted a heartfelt piece by Daegu businessman Yeo In-seong on Facebook. (5월28일 페이스북에 대구 지역 사업가 여인성 씨의 절절한 글을 올렸습니다.)

“What is the reality of our Daegu now? Young people are all leaving to find jobs, parents watch their children's faces, and children watch their parents' faces. It has become a city that is truly losing hope. Daegu's pride has crumbled, and there isn't much 'golden time' left to hesitate. Even if we elect Kim Bu-kyum, Daegu won't suddenly change into a progressive city overnight. Daegu will still be Daegu. But how long must we repeat unconditional voting, shouting ‘We are one,’ without candidates having to work for our votes? If we don't intend to waste another four years like we have experienced, we must, just this once, elect a candidate who can actually work, a capable candidate who can confidently bring central government budgets and drive a great transformation of Daegu's industries. If you truly care about conservatism, if you truly love Daegu, you must wield the stick sharply enough to wake us up. Only then will competition arise, and politicians in Daegu will learn to fear the citizens.” (“지금 우리 대구의 현실은 어떻습니까? 청년들이 일자리를 찾아 다 떠나가고, 부모는 자식 눈치를 보고 자식은 부모 눈치를 보는, 참으로 희망을 잃어가는 도시가 되었습니다. 대구의 자부심은 무너졌고, 더 이상 머뭇거릴 ‘골든타임’마저 얼마 남지 않았습니다. 우리가 김부겸을 당선시킨다고 해서 대구가 하루아침에 갑자기 진보의 도시로 바뀌지는 않습니다. 대구는 여전히 대구일 것입니다. 다만 언제까지 ‘우리가 남이가’를 외치며 일하지 않아도 표를 주는 무조건적인 투표를 반복해야 합니까? 여지껏 겪어보고도 또다시 다가올 4년을 허송세월할 작정이 아니라면, 이번 단 한 번만이라도 실질적으로 일할 수 있는 후보, 중앙정부의 예산을 당당하게 끌어와 대구의 산업을 대전환시킬 수 있는 유능한 후보를 뽑아야 합니다. 보수를 진정으로 아낀다면, 대구를 진정으로 사랑한다면 이번만큼은 정신이 번쩍 들도록 회초리를 들어야 합니다. 그래야 경쟁이 생기고, 대구 정치인들이 시민 무서운 줄을 압니다.”)

Candidate Kim Bu-kyum criticized President Lee Jae-myung's special counsel bill related to the withdrawal of the indictment. He also said about the Starbucks issue, “This is where it should stop.” This was not simply to gain votes. Candidate Kim Bu-kyum is fundamentally a politician who values common sense and integration. In terms of personal qualities, he surpasses People Power Party candidate Choo Kyoung-ho. Yet, he is struggling due to Daegu's aversion to the Democratic Party. Ultimately, whether Daegu seizes the opportunity to 'save Daegu' or remains the 'heart of conservatism' depends on the choice of Daegu citizens. (김부겸 후보는 이재명 대통령 공소취소 특검을 비판했습니다. 스타벅스도 “이 정도 선에서 그쳐야 한다”고 했습니다. 표를 얻기 위해 그런 것이 아닙니다. 김부겸 후보는 본래 상식과 통합을 중시하는 정치인입니다. 인물론에서 추경호 국민의힘 후보를 앞섭니다. 그런데도 민주당에 대한 대구의 거부감 때문에 고전하고 있습니다. 결국 대구가 ‘대구 살리기’의 기회를 잡을 것이냐, ‘보수의 심장’으로 남을 것이냐는 대구 시민의 선택에 달렸습니다.)

Daegu also has things to learn from Honam. In the 2006 local elections, Honam chose the Millennium Democratic Party over the Uri Party. In the 2016 general election, it chose Ahn Cheol-soo's People's Party over the Democratic Party. Afterwards, Democratic Party politicians did not dare to treat Honam carelessly; they feared it. Even in this election, Representative Jeong Cheong-rae is struggling with the public sentiment shifting away from the party in Jeonbuk. (대구는 호남에서 배울 점도 있습니다. 호남은 2006년 지방선거에서 열린우리당이 아니라 새천년민주당을 선택했습니다. 2016년 총선에서는 민주당이 아니라 안철수 대표의 국민의당을 선택했습니다. 그 뒤 민주당 정치인들은 호남을 함부로 대하지 못합니다. 두려워합니다. 이번 선거에서도 정청래 대표는 전북의 민심 이반에 쩔쩔매고 있습니다.)

In the early stages of the election, candidate Kim Bu-kyum, leveraging his personal competitiveness, significantly outpaced candidate Choo Kyoung-ho. item.title: Hong Jun-pyo: "Vote Using Park Geun-hye Will Only Deepen Daegu's Bleak Future" (홍준표 “박근혜 내세운 투표, 대구 미래 더 암담해질 뿐”)
item.description:
With former President Park Geun-hye joining campaign support for People Power Party Daegu mayoral candidate Choo Kyung-ho and others, former Daegu Mayor Hong Jun-pyo said, "A vote that exploits emotional appeals by trotting out former President Park will only make Daegu's future more dismal." (박근혜 전 대통령이 추경호 국민의힘 대구시장 후보 등에 대한 지원 유세에 나선 가운데, 홍준표 전 대구시장이 “박 전 대통령을 내세운 감성 자극 투표로는 대구 미래는 더 암담해질 뿐”이라고 말했다.)

In a Facebook post on the 30th, the former mayor stated, "In this local election, the reason I risked criticism and uniquely endorsed Kim Boo-kyum (Democratic Party of Korea's Daegu mayoral candidate) in the Daegu mayoral race is for the sake of Daegu’s next 100 years as a former mayor." He argued that securing government support for the TK (Daegu-Gyeongbuk) new airport and the major restructuring of Daegu's industries requires Kim's candidacy, as no one else could achieve it. <<> Regarding candidate Choo, citing his status as a defendant charged with engaging in critical duties related to insurrection, Hong questioned, "If a candidate who must attend court trials every week becomes Daegu mayor, would the Lee Jae-myung government be able to support the city of Daegu?" The former mayor added, "This is not a choice for Daegu's future 100 years, unless it’s merely a matter of Choo Kyung-ho's personal survival." <<> Meanwhile, former President Park, who visited Daegu's Chilseong Market with candidate Choo on the 23rd, subsequently toured South Chungcheong, North Chungcheong, Busan, South Gyeongsang, Gangwon, and North Gyeongbuk to support People Power Party candidates in the June 3 local elections. On the 31st, she is scheduled to visit Daegu’s Seomun Market and Suseongmot Lake again with Choo. This marks the first time Park has appeared at a campaign rally in nine years since her impeachment in 2017. <<> Reporter Lee Yoo-jin yjlee@hani.co.kr (홍 전 시장은 30일 페이스북 글에서 “이번 지방선거에서 비난을 무릅쓰고 유일하게 대구시장 선거에서 김부겸 (더불어민주당 대구시장) 후보를 지지한 것은 전임 대구시장으로서 대구 미래 100년을 위해서”라며 이같이 말했다. 티케이(TK·대구경북) 신공항, 대구산업 대개편을 위해 정부 지원을 받아야 하는데 김 후보가 아니면 할 수 없다고 본다는 것이다.)

item.title: Jung Won-oh "One More Step to the End"... Oh Se-hoon "88 Hours of Nonstop Campaigning" (정원오 “한걸음 더 끝까지”…오세훈 “88시간 무한 유세”)
item.description:
With the June 3 local elections just three days away, Jung Won-oh of the Democratic Party and Oh Se-hoon of the People Power Party, locked in a fierce battle for Seoul mayor, have launched final all-out campaigns. Jung has entered "One More Step, To the End Campaigning," while Oh began the second day of his "88 Hours of Nonstop Campaigning" schedule. (6·3 지방선거가 사흘 앞으로 다가온 가운데 서울시장 선거에서 격전을 치르고 있는 정원오 더불어민주당 후보와 오세훈 국민의힘 후보가 마지막 총력전에 나섰다. 정 후보는 ‘한 걸음 더, 끝까지 유세’에 돌입했고, 오 후보는 ‘88시간 무한 유세’ 이틀째 일정에 나섰다.)

Jung started his day on the 31st with a service at Muhak Church in Seongdong-gu, followed by a walking campaign at Paris Park in Yangcheon-gu. In the afternoon, he plans to campaign at Gocheok Sky Dome in Guro-gu, where a professional baseball game is being held, and announce development pledges for southwestern Seoul, including Guro-gu. After targeting the Gangnam area, including Gangdong-gu, Songpa-gu, and the area around Jamsugyo Bridge, he intends to meet young people in Sinchon and Seongsu-dong. Park Kyung-mi, spokesperson for Jung's campaign committee, said in a briefing, "We will appeal for voter participation, asking that the desire for change shown in early voting be carried into a victory in the main vote," adding, "We must end the incompetence and irresponsibility of Seoul and complete a change of leadership." (정 후보는 31일 첫 일정을 성동구 무학교회 예배로 시작하고, 양천구 파리공원에서 도보 유세를 펼쳤다. 오후에는 프로야구 경기가 열리는 구로구 고척스카이돔에서 유세를 진행하고, 구로구를 포함한 서울 서남권 발전 공약을 발표할 예정이다. 강동구와 송파구, 잠수교 일대 등 강남 쪽을 공략한 뒤 신촌·성수동 일대에서 청년들을 만날 계획이다. 정 후보 선거대책위원회 박경미 대변인은 브리핑에서 “사전투표에 나타난 시민들의 변화 열망을 본투표 승리로 이어 달라고 투표 참여를 호소할 것”이라며 “서울의 무능과 무책임을 끝내고 실력교체를 완성해야 한다”고 말했다.)

Oh held a press conference at the Daewang Building campaign office in Jongno-gu, Seoul, and said, "The Seoul mayor can sit in on State Council meetings," adding, "If you entrust me with the Seoul mayor position once more, I will explain and push through the 'Five Orders of Seoul Citizens' before the president." He promised to "normalize conditions for redevelopment and reconstruction projects, establish measures to prevent a 'property tax bomb,' and block the cancellation of prosecutions." He stated, "Candidate Jung, chosen by the president, will inevitably behave like a figurehead appointee," and "Seoul right now needs a protector of citizens' rights." (오 후보는 이날 서울 종로구 대왕빌딩 선거사무소에서 기자회견을 열어 “서울시장은 국무회의에 배석할 수 있다”며 “저에게 한 번 더 서울시장직을 허락해 주신다면 ‘서울시민 5대 명령’을 대통령 앞에서 설명하고 관철시키겠다”고 말했다. 그는 “재개발·재건축 정비사업 여건 정상화, 부동산 ‘세금폭탄’ 예방 장치 마련, 공소 취소를 저지” 등을 약속했다. 그는 “대통령에 의해 선택된 정 후보는 임명직 허수아비 수준으로 처신할 수밖에 없을 것”이라며 “지금 서울은 시민 권익 수호자가 필요하다”고 말했다.)

Oh plans to campaign in Gwangjin-gu, Gangdong-gu, Songpa-gu, Jongno-gu, Seodaemun-gu, Yeongdeungpo-gu, Seocho-gu, and other areas. (오 후보는 광진·강동·송파·종로·서대문·영등포·서초 등에서 유세를 할 예정이다.)

Lee Ji-eun, Reporter jieuny@hani.co.kr (이지은 기자 jieuny@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Choi Min-hee: "No police outside Starbucks... Representative Jang Dong-hyuk, go drink your coffee" (최민희 “스타벅스 앞 경찰 없어…장동혁 대표는 커피 마시라”)
item.description:
As People Power Party (PPP) Representative Jang Dong-hyuk claims the government and ruling party's criticism and boycott of Starbucks amount to "state violence" and a "kangaroo court," Democratic Party of Korea (DPK) lawmaker Choi Min-hee responded, "There are no police or soldiers outside Starbucks. Representative Jang, go drink your Starbucks coffee." (장동혁 국민의힘 대표가 정부·여당의 스타벅스 비판·불매 움직임을 “국가 폭력”, “인민재판”이라고 주장하는 가운데, 최민희 더불어민주당 의원이 “스타벅스 앞에는 경찰도, 군인도 없다. 장 대표는 스타벅스 커피 마시라”고 말했다.)

Choi, who chairs the National Assembly's Science, ICT, Broadcasting, and Communications Committee, made these remarks on Monday while appearing on Gwangju Broadcasting Corporation (KBC)'s 'NewsMaker,' stating, "Suppression by state power would involve mobilizing public authority to prevent people from drinking coffee." (국회 과학기술정보방송통신위원회 위원장인 최 의원은 31일 광주방송(KBC) ‘뉴스메이커’에 출연해 “국가 권력의 탄압이라는 것은 공권력을 동원해서 커피를 못 마시게 하는 것”이라며 이같이 말했다.)

Choi added, "Has anyone told Representative Jang not to drink Starbucks? It's just that it goes against public sentiment. You shouldn't use exaggerated and inaccurate expressions. It's unfortunate that someone who served as a judge would not use precise language." (최 의원은 “장 대표한테 누가 스타벅스 마시지 말래요? 다만 그것이 국민 정서에 반하는 것”이라며 “과장되고 정확하지 않은 표현을 쓰면 (안 된다). 판사 하신 분이 왜 이렇게 정확한 표현을 안 쓰는지 아쉽다”고 덧붙였다.)

Choi emphasized that this is "a voluntary boycott by the people." She said, "As a politician but also as one of the people, I am angry and won't go to Starbucks. My feet just won't move; I can't go. We should read the meaning of this natural emotion, not interpret it politically." (최 의원은 “국민들의 자발적인 불매 운동”임을 강조했다. 최 의원은 “나 또한 정치인이기도 하지만 국민의 한 사람으로서 분노해서 스타벅스에 안 간다. 걸음이 옮겨지지 않아서 갈 수가 없다”며 “이 자연스러운 감정의 의미를 읽어야지 정치적으로 해석하면 안 된다”고 말했다.)

Choi added, "At the very least, our people have judged that it's unacceptable to denigrate democracy, to denigrate the May 18 Democratic Uprising, to mock the families of the Sewol Ferry disaster victims, or to mock the families of the Itaewon disaster victims. When you touch these humane sentiments, this sense of compassion, the people step up, saying, 'We'll administer financial therapy.'" (최 의원은 “적어도 우리 국민들은 민주주의 폄훼는 안 된다, 5·18 폄훼는 안 된다, 세월호 유가족 조롱은 안 된다, 이태원 참사 유가족 조롱은 안 된다고 판단하고 있다”며 “인륜적인 감정, 측은지심 이걸 건드리면 ‘금융 치료’ 하겠다, 이렇게 국민들이 나선 것”이라고 덧붙였다.)

Earlier, Starbucks Korea conducted a "May 18 Tank Day" marketing campaign on May 18, the 46th anniversary of the May 18 Democratic Uprising. This drew heavy criticism for insulting the May 18 movement and the late student activist Park Jong-chul. Shinsegae Group Chairman Chung Yong-jin, whose group owns Starbucks Korea as a subsidiary, issued a public apology on May 26, saying, "I sincerely bow my head in apology and ask for forgiveness." As a nationwide boycott of Starbucks spread, the company's weekly payment amount reportedly dropped by over 8 billion won in the week following the controversy. <<> In the political sphere, the Starbucks incident has emerged as a major issue ahead of the June 3 local elections. After President Lee Jae-myung criticized the "May 18 Tank Day" marketing campaign, some government agencies stopped purchasing Starbucks gift cards or put jointly promoted projects on hold. In response, the PPP pushed back, calling it "state violence." (앞서 스타벅스코리아는 5·18 민주화운동 46주년인 지난 18일 ‘5·18 탱크데이’ 마케팅을 진행했다. 이를 두고 5·18 민주화운동과 고 박종철 열사를 모욕했다는 비판이 쏟아졌고 스타벅스코리아를 계열사로 둔 신세계그룹 정용진 회장은 26일 “진심으로 머리 숙여 사죄하고 용서를 구한다”며 공개 사과했다. 전국적으로 스타벅스 불매 운동이 확산하면서 스타벅스의 주간 결제금액은 논란 이후 일주일 사이 80억 넘게 줄어든 것으로 나타났다.)

On May 22, Representative Jang said, "This is not something the President and ministers should be doing—launching a boycott and intimidating the people. The spirit of May 18 should not become a tool of political violence to intimidate the people." The following day, on May 23, he labeled it "collective bullying led by the President" and "another form of state violence." He further argued, "On June 3, let's judge Lee Jae-myung and the Democratic Party while holding our everyday lives, our freedom, and a Starbucks coffee" (May 24); "They're trying to divert public anger over the cancellation of the special counsel investigation into Lee Jae-myung toward Starbucks. This is a kangaroo court for the local elections" (May 25); and "We must judge this unprincipled regime that tries to take away even the freedom of a cup of coffee" (May 26). On May 25, at a campaign rally in Suseongmot, Daegu, he was seen accepting a Starbucks coffee from a supporter, smiling broadly and giving a thumbs-up. (정치권에서도 스타벅스 사태는 6·3 지방선거 최대 쟁점으로 떠올랐다. 이재명 대통령이 ‘5·18 탱크데이’ 마케팅을 비판한 뒤 일부 정부 부처들이 스타벅스 상품권 구매를 중단하거나 공동으로 추진하던 사업을 보류하자 국민의힘은 “국가 폭력”이라고 반발했다.)

On May 28, at a campaign rally in Nonsan, South Chungcheong Province, Representative Jang asked, "Should we become a country like a communist state where the President meddles in every little thing, even drinking coffee?" In response, DPK spokesperson Park Ji-hye criticized him in a written briefing on May 29, saying, "The people of South Korea do not live in an era where they have to consider ideology when drinking a cup of coffee. Representative Jang's claim of a 'crisis of freedom to drink coffee' is nothing but a forced argument, let alone something to sympathize with." (장 대표는 22일 “대통령과 장관들까지 나서서 불매운동을 벌이고 국민을 겁박할 일은 아니다. 5·18정신이 국민을 겁박하는 정치적 폭력의 수단이 되어서는 안 된다”더니 23일에는 “대통령이 주도하는 집단 괴롭힘”, “또 다른 형태의 국가 폭력”이라고 주장했다. “6월3일, 우리의 소소한 일상, 우리의 자유, 스타벅스 커피 들고 이재명과 민주당을 심판하자”(24일), “이재명 재판 취소 특검에 분노한 민심을 스타벅스로 돌리려 하고 있다. 지방선거용 인민재판이다”(25일), “커피 한 잔의 자유마저 뺏어가려는 무도한 정권을 심판해야 한다”(26일)고도 했다. 25일 대구 수성못 유세 현장에서는 한 지지자로부터 스타벅스 커피를 건네받고 환하게 웃으며 엄지를 치켜세우는 모습도 포착됐다.)

Reporter Lee Yoo-jin yjlee@hani.co.kr (장 대표는 28일에도 충남 논산 유세 현장에서 “커피 마시는 것 하나 대통령이 일일이 간섭하는 공산당의 나라가 되어도 되겠나”라고 했는데 이를 두고 박지혜 민주당 대변인은 29일 서면 브리핑에서 “대한민국 국민은 커피 한 잔을 마실 때도 이념을 따져야 하는 시대를 살고 있지 않다. 장 대표가 주장하는 ‘커피 마실 자유의 위기’는 공감은커녕 억지 주장에 불과하다”고 비판했다.)

item.title: Oh Se-hoon: "If elected, I will attend state council meetings" – Democratic Party: "Like a student skipping class, getting an F, and retaking the course" (오세훈 “당선 땐 국무회의 참석”-민주 “수업 빠져 F 맞고 재수강하나”)
item.description:
Oh Se-hoon, the People Power Party candidate for Seoul mayor, has stated that if elected, he would attend state council meetings to push through his pledges in front of President Lee Jae-myung, prompting the Democratic Party to push back, calling it an "arrogant notion." (오세훈 국민의힘 서울시장 후보가 자신이 당선되면 국무회의에 참여해 이재명 대통령 앞에서 자신의 공약을 관철시키겠다고 밝힌 것에 대해 더불어민주당이 “오만한 발상”이라며 반발했다.)

Jo Seung-rae, Secretary-General of the Democratic Party, said at a press briefing on the 31st: "Since the Lee Jae-myung administration took office, 56 state council meetings have been held. Oh attended only two of them, claiming he was too busy with mayoral duties. For someone who barely showed up to now talk like this, it's like a college student skipping class, getting an F grade, and saying they'll retake the course. There's no retake here." Spokesperson Park Kyung-mi also issued a written statement, saying, "The Seoul mayor's right to attend state council meetings is a duty to convey on-the-ground public concerns to state affairs, not an authority to boost political leverage. Oh's declaration that he would immediately attend state council meetings and confront the president upon election is truly an arrogant thought." (조승래 더불어민주당 사무총장은 31일 기자간담회에서 “이재명 정부 출범 이후 국무회의가 56회 열렸는데 오 후보는 시장 일이 바쁘다고 대부분 불참하고, 단 두 차례 참석했다. 참석도 안 하던 사람이 이렇게 얘기하는 건 대학생이 수업 빠지고 에프(F)학점 맞고 재수강 하겠다는 것”이라며 “재수강은 없다”고 말했다. 박경미 대변인도 서면 브리핑을 내어 “서울시장의 국무회의 배석권은 민생 현장을 국정에 전달하라는 책무이지, 정치적 체급을 키우기 위해 사용하라는 권한이 아니다”라며 “오 후보가 당선 즉시 국무회의에 참석해 대통령과 맞서겠다고 공언한 것은 참으로 오만한 발상”이라고 했다.)

Earlier that morning, Oh held a press conference, mentioning the Seoul mayor's right to attend state council meetings, and said, "If you grant me the Seoul mayor position once more, I will explain and push through the 'Five Orders of Seoul Citizens' before the president." The 'Five Orders' he outlined include normalizing conditions for redevelopment and reconstruction projects, establishing measures to prevent a real estate 'tax bomb,' and blocking the cancellation of indictments. During an afternoon campaign stop in Gangdong-gu, he also said, "At the end of my term, unsure whether to continue, I felt a bit weakened. But if you empower me to do it again, I will enter state council meetings and confidently convey your will." (앞서 오 후보는 이날 오전 기자회견을 열어 서울시장의 국무회의 배석권을 언급하며 “저에게 한 번 더 서울시장직을 허락해 주신다면 ‘서울시민 5대 명령’을 대통령 앞에서 설명하고 관철시키겠다”고 말했다. 그가 밝힌 ‘5대 명령’은 재개발·재건축 정비사업 여건 정상화, 부동산 ‘세금폭탄’ 예방 장치 마련, 공소 취소 저지 등이다. 그는 오후 강동구 유세에서도 “(시장) 임기 말에 더 계속할지 못할지 모르는 입장에서 조금은 힘이 빠져 있었지만, 여러분이 힘을 실어주셔서 다시 할 수 있게 되면 국무회의에 들어가 당당하게 여러분 뜻을 전달하겠다”고 말했다.)

In response, Jeong Won-oh, the Democratic Party candidate for Seoul mayor, said at a campaign rally at Gil-dong Bokjori Market in Gangdong-gu that day: "The Seoul mayor's role is not to fight the president. A person who aims to fight the president to rebuild conservatism should not be elected. Can we let Oh, who seeks to hamstring a competent president to fulfill political ambitions, get away with this?" (이에 정원오 더불어민주당 서울시장 후보는 이날 강동구 길동복조리시장 유세에서 “서울시장은 대통령과 싸우는 자리가 아니다. 대통령과 싸워 보수를 재건하겠다는 자가 당선되면 안 된다”며 “일 잘하는 대통령을 발목 잡아 정치적 야욕을 채우고자 하는 오 후보를 이대로 놔둬도 되겠냐”고 말했다.)

Article 8, Paragraph 1 of the State Council Regulations states: "The Seoul mayor shall attend state council meetings (omitted). However, if the chair deems it necessary, it may allow public officials in important positions to attend." Unlike other regional heads, the Seoul mayor has both the authority and duty to attend state council meetings. However, since they are not state council members, they have no voting rights, only speaking rights. During the Roh Moo-hyun administration, the Seoul mayor was excluded from attending state council meetings but was reinstated under the Lee Myung-bak administration. The Seoul mayor's attendance rate at state council meetings tends to be higher when they belong to the ruling party compared to the opposition. (국무회의 규정 제8조 1항은 “국무회의에는 (중략) 서울특별시장이 배석한다. 다만, 의장이 필요하다고 인정하는 경우에는 중요 직위에 있는 공무원을 배석하게 할 수 있다”고 되어 있다. 다른 광역단체장들과 달리 국무회의에 배석할 권한과 의무가 있는 것이다. 다만 국무위원이 아니기 때문에 의결권은 없고 발언권만 있다. 노무현 정부 때 서울시장을 국무회의 배석자에서 제외했다가 이명박 정부 때 다시 포함시켰다. 서울시장의 국무회의 참석률은 여당 소속일 때가 야당 소속일 때보다 높은 경향을 보인다.)

Reporter Lee Ji-eun, jieuny@hani.co.kr (이지은 기자 jieuny@hani.co.kr)

item.title: 'I am the genuine democratic reform candidate'... Kim Yong-nam and Cho Kuk intensify real vs. fake debate (‘내가 찐 민주개혁 후보’…김용남-조국, 진짜·가짜 공방 격화)
item.description:
The 'real vs. fake candidate' dispute between Kim Yong-nam, the Democratic Party of Korea candidate running in the Pyeongtaek-eul National Assembly by-election, and Cho Kuk, the candidate of the Cho Kuk Innovation Party, is intensifying in the final stages of the election. (경기 평택을 국회의원 재선거에 출마한 김용남 더불어민주당 후보와 조국 조국혁신당 후보 간 ‘진짜·가짜 후보’ 공방이 선거 막판 격화하고 있다.)

On the 31st, at a central election strategy committee meeting held at the Pyeongtaek election office, Candidate Cho said, “The Democratic Party’s Pyeongtaek-eul candidate and some of its leadership opposed building a larger and stronger democratic reform camp,” adding, “This is politics of noise, abandoning the greater cause and indulging in self-serving politics.” He then directed his remarks at the Democratic Party leadership, stating, “This behavior goes directly against the hopes of Pyeongtaek citizens and the people of the democratic reform camp,” and saying, “It has become clear who is the right person to fulfill the aspirations of the great citizens of Pyeongtaek and the democratic reform camp.” (조 후보는 31일 평택시 선거사무소에서 열린 중앙선거대책위원회 회의에서 “민주당의 평택을 후보와 일부 지도부는 더 크고 더 단단해지는 민주개혁 진영을 만드는 일에 반대했다”며 “대의를 버리고 자기 정치에만 골몰한 소리의 정치”라고 말했다. 그는 이어 민주당 지도부를 향해 “평택시민과 민주개혁 진영 국민의 바람과는 정반대로 가는 행태”라며 “누가 위대한 평택시민과 민주개혁 진영의 염원을 실천할 적임자인지 분명해졌다”고 말했다.)

Candidate Cho’s remarks on this day were aimed at the Democratic Party leadership, including Cho Seung-rae, the party’s general election strategy committee chief, who had visited Pyeongtaek the previous day to support Candidate Kim. At a field command staff meeting held at Candidate Kim’s election office, Committee Chief Cho said, “Candidate Kim Yong-nam, chosen by President Lee Jae-myung and nominated by the Democratic Party, is the true Democratic Party candidate,” and “A fake Democratic Party candidate is deceiving people as if they were real,” targeting Candidate Cho. At a press briefing at the National Assembly that same day, Committee Chief Cho also criticized Candidate Cho, asking, “Why are you wearing the mask of the Democratic Party and running in the election?” (이날 조 후보의 발언은 전날 김 후보를 지원하기 위해 평택을 찾았던 조승래 민주당 총괄선거대책본부장 등 민주당 지도부를 겨냥한 것이다. 조 선대본부장은 김 후보 선거사무소에서 열린 현장 본부장단 회의에서 “이재명 대통령이 선택하고 민주당이 공천한 김용남 후보가 진짜 민주당 후보”, “가짜 민주당 후보가 마치 진짜인 것처럼 사람들을 현혹하고 있다”며 조 후보를 겨냥했다. 조 선대본부장은 이날 국회 기자간담회에서도 “왜 민주당이란 가면을 쓰고 선거를 하느냐”고 조 후보를 비판했다.)

The camps of Candidate Kim and Candidate Cho also exchanged sharp statements. Candidate Kim’s camp said this day, addressing Innovation Party lawmakers, “You entered the National Assembly in the last general election with the unprecedented fraud of ‘district candidates for the Democratic Party, proportional representation candidates for the Cho Kuk Innovation Party’,” and said, “Stop the fake Democratic Party marketing.” In response, Candidate Cho’s camp highlighted controversies surrounding Candidate Kim, stating, “It would be a courtesy to the people and the voters of Pyeongtaek-eul to offer an explanation for the hot news article that ‘Candidate Kim’s loan shark business was still operating until recently’.” (김 후보 캠프와 조 후보 캠프도 날 선 논평을 주고받았다. 김 후보 캠프는 이날 혁신당 의원들을 향해 “지난 총선에서 ‘지민비조’(지역구 후보는 민주당, 비례대표 후보는 조국혁신당)라는 희대의 사기극으로 국회에 입성하신 분들”이라며 “가짜 민주당 마케팅은 그만두라”고 했다. 그러자 조 후보 캠프에선 “‘김 후보의 대부업체 최근까지 운영 중’이라는 따끈따끈한 기사에 대해 해명을 내놓는 게 국민과 평택을 유권자에 대한 예의”라며 김 후보 관련 논란을 부각했다.)

Reporter Choi Ha-yan chy@hani.co.kr (최하얀 기자 chy@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Jeong Cheong-rae in Honam: "Filial Politics"… Jang Dong-hyuk in Seoul: "Freedom of Coffee" (정청래, 호남서 “효도정치”…장동혁, 서울서 “커피의 자유”)
item.description:
On May 31, the last Sunday before the June 3 local elections, leaders of both the ruling and opposition parties visited competitive districts to appeal for voter support. Jeong Cheong-rae, leader of the Democratic Party of Korea, in South Jeolla and Chungcheong, said, "Please choose a strong ruling party candidate," while Jang Dong-hyuk, leader of the People Power Party, stated, "Let's protect the freedom of a cup of coffee through voting." <<> Leader Jeong held a support rally in the morning in Gurye, South Jeolla, for Democratic Party candidate for Gurye County Mayor, Jang Gil-seon, saying, "Regardless of whether you like us or not, please vote for ballot number 1. We will ensure the Democratic Party does filial politics well for Honam." Recently, Jeong has been focusing on the Honam region, where despite being a traditional stronghold for the Democratic Party, candidates from the Fatherland Innovation Party or independents are expected to advance. <<> In the afternoon, Leader Jeong visited Geumsan in South Chungcheong, Yeongdong in North Chungcheong, and Boeun in North Chungcheong in succession. At each rally, he did not miss the chance to say that budget and legislative support are needed for regional development, and for that, a ruling party candidate must be elected. Leader Jeong said, "Those who think the president is doing a good job should come out to the polls." <<> Jang Dong-hyuk, leader of the People Power Party, along with party leadership, held a rally targeting youth near Hongdae Station in Mapo-gu, Seoul, in the afternoon. They also visited Seongsu-dong in Seongdong-gu and near Gangnam Station in Gangnam-gu. Oh Se-hoon, the People Power Party candidate for Seoul Mayor, did not join Jang's schedule. Wearing a red apron with the phrase "Freedom of a cup of coffee," Jang conducted a walking rally. This appears to be an attempt to use the recent controversy over Starbucks' "Tank Day" event—criticized by the government and ruling party—as a lever to rally conservative support. This marked Jang's second campaign rally in Seoul during the election period, following one on the 26th. <<> Earlier, Jang held a press conference at the People Power Party headquarters in Yeouido, Seoul, claiming, "Giving up on voting means giving Lee Jae-myung, who abuses presidential power, a chance to erase all his crimes. If the arrogant Lee Jae-myung and the Democratic Party win the local elections and take control of local governments, they will push through the cancellation of Lee's trial, strip away citizens' freedoms one by one, and transform South Korea into a massive distribution system." <<> Reporters: Yoo Young-jae and Choi Ha-yan young@hani.co.kr (6·3 지방선거 전 마지막 일요일인 31일, 여야 지도부는 접전지를 찾아 표심을 모아줄 것을 호소했다. 정청래 더불어민주당 대표는 전남과 충청에서 “힘 있는 여당 후보를 선택해달라”고 했고, 장동혁 국민의힘 대표는 “커피 한 잔의 자유, 투표로 지키자”고 말했다.)

item.title: President Lee Urges Voter Turnout, Mentions “Old Guard Entrenched Interests”… People Power Party Criticizes as “Divide and Conquer” (이 대통령 ‘구태 기득권’ 언급하며 투표 독려…국힘 “국민 갈라치기”)
item.description:
President Lee Jae-myung, three days before the June 3 local elections, urged voter turnout on the 31st, stating, “Whether those elected become loyal servants enriching my life or malignant rulers destroying the world and inflicting pain on the people rests in the hands of the sovereign.” The People Power Party strongly criticized this, saying, “He’s trying to divide the people.” (이재명 대통령이 6·3 지방선거 사흘 전인 31일 “선출된 그들이 내 삶을 풍요롭게 만드는 충직한 머슴이 될지, 세상을 파괴하고 국민에게 고통을 주는 악성 지배자가 될지는 주권자의 손에 달려 있다”며 투표를 독려했다. 국민의힘은 “국민을 갈라치려 한다”며 강하게 비판했다.)

President Lee said on X (formerly Twitter) that day, “Depending on the mindset and attitude of elected officials, the world can become either a hell or a heaven,” and added, “If any politician or political group finds this statement uncomfortable, they are the old guard entrenched interests that the sovereign must overcome through voting.” He also introduced a quote from the Greek philosopher Plato: “The price of indifference to politics is being ruled by the worst scoundrels.” The previous day, President Lee also said, “Giving up voting is like giving up the future of myself and my family,” and “Giving up voting is not neutrality but siding with those who harm my life and community.” <<> President Lee’s series of messages appear to encourage voter participation while urging consolidation among his support base and centrist voters. <<> In particular, the People Power Party is pushing back against the use of intense terms like “malignant rulers” and “old guard entrenched interests.” Deputy Chairman of the Standing Election Campaign Committee, Jang Dong-hyuk, held a press conference at the National Assembly that day, saying, “(President Lee) has mobilized all sorts of attacks, calling the conservative opposition malignant rulers and old guard entrenched interests. As the election landscape turns unfavorable, he’s trying to divide the people. You must judge him.” <<> The People Power Party also criticized President Lee for walking out with his marked ballot paper while voting on the first day of early voting, May 29. During the voting process at the early voting station in Samcheong-dong Community Center, Seoul, near the presidential office, President Lee entered the voting booth, briefly came out holding the ballot paper, and asked, “Is it okay if only half of it is stamped?” before re-entering the booth and completing the vote. In response, the People Power Party’s Central Election Campaign Committee Spokesperson, Choi Bo-yoon, commented, “This is a staged public vote carried out in a sense of crisis at the end of the election, and a communist-style public vote.” The People Power Party reported President Lee to the police that day on suspicion of violating the Public Official Election Act. <<> Reporter Seo Young-ji yj@hani.co.kr ( 이 대통령은 이날 엑스(X·옛 트위터)에 “선출된 공직자가 어떤 마음과 자세로 어떻게 하느냐에 따라 세상은 지옥이 될 수도 천국이 될 수도 있다”며 “이 말이 불편한 정치인이나 정치집단이 있다면 그들이 바로 주권자가 투표로써 극복해야 할 구태 기득권자들”이라고 말했다. 그러면서 그리스 철학자 플라톤의 “정치 무관심의 대가는 최악의 저질들에게 지배당하는 것”이라는 경구를 소개하기도 했다. 이 대통령은 전날에도 “투표를 포기하는 것은 나와 가족의 미래를 포기하는 것과 같다”며 “투표 포기는 중립이 아니라 내 삶과 공동체를 해치는 그들을 편드는 것”이라고 말했다.)

item.title: President Lee on Insults to Victims of Social Disasters: “Even a Beast Knows Shame…We Will Be Strict” (이 대통령, 사회적 참사 모욕에 “인면수심도 유분수지…엄단”)
item.description:
On the 31st, President Lee Jae-myung stated regarding acts that insult victims and their families of social disasters, "We will investigate more thoroughly and crack down strictly in the future." (이재명 대통령이 31일 사회적 참사 피해자와 유가족을 모욕하는 행위와 관련해 “앞으로 더 철저히 수사하고 엄단할 것”이라고 했다.)

President Lee wrote this while sharing a media report on X (formerly Twitter) that a suspect who had repeatedly posted false information about the Sewol Ferry, Itaewon, and Jeju Air disasters over a long period was arrested. President Lee said, "Even a beast knows shame, to what extent can this go? Why are you doing this?" and "Think about it if it were your own family who suffered such damage. Shouldn't we practice empathy?" (이 대통령은 이날 엑스(X·옛 트위터)에 세월호·이태원·제주여객기 참사와 관련한 허위정보를 장기간 반복해 올린 피의자가 구속됐다는 언론 보도를 공유하며 이렇게 적었다. 이 대통령은 “인면수심도 유분수지 대체 왜 이러는 것이냐”라며 “자신의 가족이 그런 피해를 입었다고 생각해보자 역지사지해야 하지 않을까”라고 했다.)

The National Investigation Headquarters of the National Police Agency announced on the same day that a man in his 50s, identified as Mr. K, who had posted over 3,000 false posts related to social disasters on major domestic communities and platforms from 2022 to 2026, was arrested the previous day. Mr. K is suspected of continuously posting false statements such as "The Sewol Ferry was a staged mass deception, a performance," "The Itaewon accident was a poorly made film where they played with dolls and staged corpses," and "The airliner accident was a scam profiting from bodies," thereby insulting and defaming the families of the victims. (경찰청 국가수사본부는 이날 2022∼2026년까지 국내 주요 커뮤니티와 플랫폼에 사회적 참사와 관련한 허위 글 3000여건을 올린 50대 남성 ㄱ씨가 전날 구속됐다고 밝혔다. ㄱ씨는 ‘세월호는 짜고 친 대국민 사기, 연출된 것’, ‘이태원 사고는 더미 놓고 시체놀이 한 부실한 영화’, ‘여객기 사고는 시체팔이 한 사기극’ 등 허위 글을 지속해서 올려 유가족을 모욕하고 명예를 훼손한 혐의를 받는다.)

item.title: Ahn Gyu-baek Emphasizes Wartime Operational Control Transfer to U.S. Congressional Delegation; Hegseth Also "Welcomes" (안규백, 미 의회 대표단에 전작권 환수 강조…헤그세스도 “환영”)
item.description:
South Korean Defense Minister Ahn Gyu-baek met with a U.S. congressional delegation from the Senate and House of Representatives on the sidelines of the Shangri-La Dialogue in Singapore, stating that he "fully explained the agreement between South Korea and the U.S. in 2020 that conditions for transferring 94% of wartime operational control (OPCON) had been met," reiterating his determination to reclaim OPCON. <<> Minister Ahn told reporters in Singapore on the 31st, "I conveyed to the U.S. lawmakers that the condition-based OPCON transition has been sufficiently achieved, and even if OPCON were transferred tomorrow, there would be no difficulties," adding, "The U.S. lawmakers seemed to understand and were satisfied with our OPCON preparations." Minister Ahn, attending the 23rd Asia Security Summit in Singapore, met with the U.S. Senate delegation and the U.S. House delegation on the 30th and 31st, respectively. <<> In his earlier speech at the Asia Security Summit on the 30th, Minister Ahn also emphasized the will to reclaim OPCON, stating, "Our military is actively enhancing independent capabilities for South Korea-led defense of the Korean Peninsula while maintaining a robust South Korea-U.S. joint defense posture." He said this while adding, "We will pursue parallel efforts to strengthen the alliance and self-reliant defense." U.S. Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth, attending the same conference, commented on South Korea's OPCON transfer, saying, "It is encouraging that an ally wants faster and greater control," and added, "I welcome it." Referring to South Korea's promise to increase defense spending to 3.5% of GDP, he stated, "I applaud the pragmatism and leadership shown by South Korea." Minister Ahn described Secretary Hegseth's remarks as "very significant." The Lee Jae-myung government aims to achieve OPCON transfer by the end of 2027 at the earliest. However, U.S. Forces Korea Commander General Xavier Brunson has emphasized that the OPCON transition should focus on conditions, not timing. <<> In his speech that day, Minister Ahn also said, "We are participating in various international efforts for the security of the Strait of Hormuz, and actively reviewing practical contribution plans considering domestic laws," but refrained from specifying the details of such contributions. <<> Minister Ahn also revealed to reporters on the 31st that he discussed a South Korea-Japan Acquisition and Cross-Servicing Agreement (ACSA) during his defense ministerial meeting with Japanese Defense Minister Shinjiro Koizumi on the morning of the 30th. This marks the first time the current government has officially acknowledged discussing ACSA with Japan. The ACSA is an agreement allowing the two countries to exchange military supplies such as ammunition, food, and fuel during contingencies. <<> Minister Ahn stated, "The ACSA is an area that requires understanding and persuasion of the people of both countries, and I believe we need to exercise caution for now." Japan has strongly hoped to conclude an ACSA, but the South Korean government has maintained a cautious stance, largely due to concerns that the agreement could "serve as a channel for the Japanese Self-Defense Forces to enter the Korean Peninsula." Even the Yoon Suk Yeol government, mindful of public opinion, stated that "the government does not consent to or review the ACSA." <<> The Ministry of National Defense emphasized that there has been no change in the government's position, stating, "The ACSA is currently premature and not under review." <<> Reporter Kwon Hyuk-chul nura@hani.co.kr (안규백 국방부 장관이 싱가포르 아시아안보회의(샹그릴라 대화)를 계기로 미국 상·하원 의회 대표단을 만나 “2020년 한·미 양국이 94%의 전시작전통제권(전작권) 전환 조건이 충족됐다는 것에 합의한 내용 등을 충분히 설명했다”며 거듭 전작권 환수 의지를 강조했다.)

item.title: 'Lee Myung-bak and Park Geun-hye' Come to Forefront of Election…Even Within PPP, "Negative Impact on Moderates" (‘이명박근혜’ 선거 전면에…국힘서도 “중도층 악영향”)
item.description:
Former Presidents Lee Myung-bak and Park Geun-hye jointly hit the campaign trail on the 31st to support candidates of the People Power Party (PPP) in the June 3 local elections. This move is interpreted as an attempt to consolidate conservative support, particularly in the competitive Yeongnam region. However, criticism is emerging both within and outside the party that it is inappropriate for the two former presidents—who were sentenced to prison time after facing judicial scrutiny and later pardoned—to join the election campaign. (이명박·박근혜 전 대통령이 31일 나란히 6·3 지방선거 국민의힘 후보 지원 유세에 나섰다. 판세가 팽팽히 맞서는 영남권을 중심으로 보수층 결집을 노린 행보로 풀이되지만, 사법적 심판을 받고 실형을 산 뒤 사면된 두 전직 대통령의 선거전 등판이 적절하지 않다는 비판이 당 안팎에서 나오고 있다.)

Former President Park Geun-hye visited Seomun Market in Jung-gu, Daegu, around 4 p.m. on this day alongside PPP Daegu mayoral candidate Choo Kyoung-ho, appealing for support. Park stated, "Candidate Choo is the right person to revive Daegu's economy. When Candidate Choo worked as Minister of the Office for Government Policy Coordination under my administration, we coordinated well, and he did an excellent job," adding, "Please give him overwhelming support." This marks Park's second campaign stop in Daegu, following a visit to Chilseong Market on the 23rd. She continued her support for Candidate Choo at Suseongmot Lake in Suseong-gu, Daegu. Starting in Daegu on the 23rd, Park has been traversing the country—including Daejeon, Okcheon and Gongju in Chungcheongbuk-do (25th), Jinju in Gyeongnam, Ulsan, and Busan (27th), Wonju in Gangwon (28th), and Changwon and Namhae in Gyeongnam (29th)—conducting campaign activities akin to a "election committee chairperson" level. <<> On the same day, former President Lee Myung-bak visited Busan to support PPP Busan mayoral candidate Park Hyung-joon. Candidate Park is a prominent figure from the pro-Lee faction, having served as Senior Secretary to the President for Public Relations and Senior Secretary for Political Affairs during the Lee Myung-bak administration. During a campaign rally at Haeundae Traditional Market in Haeundae-gu, Busan, around 1 p.m., Lee said, "Just as Seoul developed when I was its mayor, even as an opposition party mayor, Busan's future is determined not by who is president, but by who is its mayor. If Candidate Park serves four more years as mayor, Busan's population will grow, and young people and tourists will flock there." Earlier that morning, Lee visited Suryeong-ro Church in Haeundae-gu, worshiped alongside Candidate Park, and had pork soup. On the 15th, Lee had walked along Cheonggyecheon in Jung-gu, Seoul, with Seoul mayoral candidate Oh Se-hoon. <<> Skeptical voices are also prevalent within the party. A two-term lawmaker from the Yeongnam region told *The Hankyoreh*, "It might be effective in rallying traditional conservative supporters in Yeongnam and getting them to the polls," but added, "However, I question the scalability of their influence. It's uncertain whether they can draw moderates—the swing voters who decide election outcomes—to our side." A first-term lawmaker said, "The party leaning on a flawed past will not be good for us in the long run, as we need to move toward rebuilding conservatism." <<> The Democratic Party of Korea (DPK) strongly criticized the move. DPK leader Jung Cheong-rae, at a campaign rally in Gurye, South Jeolla Province, said, "Yoon, Lee, and Park are now roaming around," linking the "Yoon Again" forces within the PPP with former Presidents Park and Lee, calling them the "Three Prisoners." Jung continued, "This is a regression to the past, a distortion of democracy, and a disregard for the people." DPK Secretary General Cho Seung-rae also said at a press briefing at the National Assembly, "These are presidents who went to prison for corruption and were impeached and removed for abuse of power," adding, "A majority of reasonable citizens will not tolerate this." Political commentator Park Sang-byung told *The Hankyoreh*, "The former presidents have stepped to the forefront because they see it as an opportunity to recover their weakened political presence and restore their honor. Former presidents, as the nation's foremost elders, have a duty to present a national vision regardless of party affiliation, but engaging in election campaigns for the benefit of a specific political party is itself shameful." <<> Reported by Kim Hae-jung and Kim Chae-un, sea@hani.co.kr (박근혜 전 대통령은 이날 오후 4시께 추경호 국민의힘 대구시장 후보와 함께 대구 중구 서문시장을 찾아 지지를 호소했다. 박 전 대통령은 “추 후보는 대구 경제를 살리는 데 적임자다. 추 후보가 국무조정실장으로 일할 때 저와 호흡을 맞춰서 일했는데, 그때 참 일을 잘했다”며 “압도적 지지를 보내달라”고 했다. 박 전 대통령의 대구 지원 유세는 지난 23일 대구 칠성시장 방문에 이어 두번째다. 그는 대구 수성구 수성못에서도 추 후보 지원 유세를 이어갔다. 박 전 대통령은 지난 23일 대구를 시작으로, 대전, 충북 옥천·공주(25일), 경남 진주, 울산, 부산(27일), 강원 원주(28일), 경남 창원·남해(29일) 등 전국을 두루 돌며 ‘선거대책위원장급’ 지원 유세를 벌이고 있다.)

item.title: Jeong Won-oh: "End to Safety Insensitivity," Oh Se-hoon: "No Puppet Mayor"... Seoul's Blitz Campaigns (정원오 “안전불감 끝장” 오세훈 “허수아비 안돼”…서울 광폭 유세)
item.description:
On the final Sunday before the local election vote, May 31, both Jeong Won-oh, the Democratic Party of Korea candidate for Seoul mayor, and Oh Se-hoon, the People Power Party candidate, launched all-out campaigns. On this day, the two candidates traversed all of Seoul to appeal to voters, seeking to meet as many weekend voters who had taken to the streets as possible. (지방선거 본투표 전 마지막 일요일인 31일, 정원오 더불어민주당 서울시장 후보와 오세훈 국민의힘 후보가 총력전에 나섰다. 이날 두 후보는 주말을 맞아 거리로 나온 유권자들을 한명이라도 더 만나기 위해 서울 전 지역을 훑으며 표심을 호소했다.)

Candidate Jeong decided to hold a "One More Step, All the Way to the End" campaign over three days, starting from this day until midnight on June 2, when official electioneering ends. Jeong began his day with a service at Muhak Church in Seongdong-gu, then toured Yangcheon → Guro → Gangdong → Songpa → Seocho → Seodaemun → Seongdong. He visited Gocheok Sky Dome in Guro-gu, Seokchon Lake in Songpa-gu, and the Jamsu Bridge Festival site in Seocho-gu to meet voters. Both the start and end of the day's campaign were in Seongdong-gu. Jeong's camp explained this as "a sign of not forgetting his original commitment as the head of Seongdong-gu." (정 후보는 이날부터 공식 선거운동이 종료되는 6월2일 자정까지 3일간 ‘한걸음 더 끝까지 유세’를 펼치기로 했다. 정 후보는 이날 오전 성동구 무학교회 예배를 시작으로 양천 →구로 →강동 →송파 →서초 →서대문 →성동 등을 누볐다. 구로구 고척스카이 돔 , 송파구 석촌호수, 서초구 잠수교 축제 현장을 찾아 유권자들과 만났 다. 이날 유세의 시작과 끝은 모두 성동구였다. 정 후보 쪽은 “성동구청장으로서의 초심을 잃지 않겠다는 뜻”이라고 설명했다.)

Candidate Oh began his "88-Hour Vortex Infinite Campaign" at 8 a.m. on May 30. On this day alone, he sequentially toured Gwangjin → Gangdong → Songpa → Yongsan → Jongno → Seodaemun → Yeongdeungpo → Seocho. Starting with a campaign speech at Achasan in Gwangjin-gu, he met citizens at Gangdong Amsa General Market, Jamsil Baseball Stadium in Songpa-gu, Dongmyo Flea Market in Jongno-gu, and Times Square in Yeongdeungpo. Cho Eun-hee, the general election committee head for Oh's camp, explained the background for choosing these campaign locations: "The intent is to implement an integrated municipal administration responsible for citizens' entire life cycle—from housewives' livelihoods, to seniors' welfare, and to the future of youth." <<> On this day, Jeong highlighted the omission of rebar at the Samsung Station on the GTX-A line, repeatedly expressing concerns over Oh's "safety insensitivity." At the Gocheok Sky Dome campaign, Jeong emphasized, "Candidate Oh is acting as if the rebar omission at Samsung Station is someone else's problem, not his responsibility. We must change a mayor with safety insensitivity. Otherwise, accidents will continue to happen, and citizens will be so anxious they cannot lead their daily lives." <<> Candidate Oh brought up the theory of judging the government. Before his campaign on this day, Oh held a press conference at his Jongno-gu election office and stated, "Candidate Jeong, chosen by the president to become a candidate, will inevitably behave at a puppet level. Right now, Seoul needs a guardian of citizens' rights and interests, not a puppet." Oh added, "If you grant me the position of Seoul mayor once more, I will attend the State Council meeting immediately after my term begins, explain the 'Five Mandates of Seoul Citizens' in front of the president, and see them through." Oh mentioned normalizing conditions for redevelopment and reconstruction projects, revitalizing private rental housing supply, establishing preventive measures against real estate 'tax bombs,' easing metropolitan area regulations, and preventing the revocation of prosecutions. <<> Afterward, at a campaign event at Amsa Station in Gangdong-gu, Oh referenced a message posted by President Lee Jae-myung on X (formerly Twitter) the day before—"Abstaining from voting is not neutrality but siding with those who harm my life and our community"—and said, "Shouldn't a president at least say that they will embrace everyone and govern with politics? There's no way until two years later (when general elections are held) to make such a presidential mindset humble." <<> In response, at a campaign event at Gil-dong Bokjori Market in Gangdong-gu, Jeong raised his voice, saying, "The Seoul mayor's position is not about fighting with the president. A person who says they will fight the president to rebuild conservatism should not be elected. Can we just leave Candidate Oh, who aims to obstruct a competent president's work to fulfill his own political ambitions?" <<> Reporter Go Kyung-joo goh@hani.co.kr Reporter Yoo Young-jae young@hani.co.kr (오 후보는 30일 아침 8시부터 ‘88시간 회오리 무한유세’를 펼치고 있다. 이날에만 광진→강동→송파→용산→종로→서대문→영등포→서초를 차례로 훑었다. 광진구 아차산 유세를 시작으로 강동 암사종합시장, 송파구 잠실야구장, 종로구 동묘 벼룩시장, 영등포 타임스퀘어 등에서 시민들과 만났다. 오 후보 캠프의 조은희 총괄선거대책본부장은 유세 장소를 택한 배경과 관련해 “주부의 민생, 어르신의 복지, 청년의 미래까지 시민의 전 생애주기를 책임지는 통합형 시정을 펼치겠다는 취지”라고 설명했다.)

item.title: Early Voting Rate Hits Record High: Ruling Party Says "Will to Judge Insurrection," Opposition Says "Expression of Regime Judgment" (사전투표율 역대 최고…여 “내란 심판 의지” 야 “정권 심판론 표출”)
item.description:
On the 31st, the ruling and opposition parties each interpreted the early voting rate (23.51%) for the June 3 local elections—which marked the highest ever for a local election—as a result favorable to themselves. The Democratic Party of Korea emphasized that it reflected "the people's will to judge the insurrection," while the People Power Party highlighted that it showed "judgment against the Democratic Party and the Lee Jae-myung regime." (여야가 31일 지방선거 사상 최고치를 기록한 6·3 지방선거 사전투표율(23.51%)을 두고 저마다 자신들에게 유리한 결과로 나타날 것이라는 해석을 내놨다. 더불어민주당은 “국민의 내란 심판 의지”가 드러난 것이라고 강조했고, 국민의힘은 “민주당과 이재명 정권 심판론”이 나타난 것이라고 부각했다.)

Kang Jun-hyun, senior spokesperson for the Democratic Party, said at a press conference at the National Assembly on the 31st, "It is not appropriate to discuss election advantages or disadvantages based on whether the early voting rate is high or low," but added, "It reflects the political judgment against the insurrection forces and the will to support the state affairs of the Lee Jae-myung government. It shows that the public has a tremendous interest in these local elections and parliamentary by-elections." Rep. Jeong Cheong-rae, the party's general election committee chairman, also told reporters on the 30th after a campaign rally in Hadong, South Gyeongsang Province, "Most of the people standing in line (at polling stations) are young people," adding, "If many young people came out, a high early voting rate is at least not unfavorable to the Democratic Party." (강준현 민주당 수석대변인은 31일 국회에서 기자회견을 열어 “사전투표율이 높고 낮음에 따라 선거 유불리를 말하는 것은 적절하지 않다”면서도 “내란 세력에 대한 정치적 심판과 이재명 정부 국정에 대한 뒷받침 의지가 반영된 것이다. 이번 지방선거나 국회의원 재보궐선거에 국민 관심이 지대하다는 걸 보여준다”고 말했다. 당 총괄상임선거대책위원장인 정청래 대표도 지난 30일 경남 하동 유세 뒤 기자들에게 “(투표장에) 줄 서 있는 분들이 대부분 젊은 층”이라며 “젊은 층이 많이 나왔다면 사전투표율이 높은 건 민주당에 적어도 불리하지 않다”고 말했다.)

The People Power Party said the result showed voters responding to "judgment against the arrogant government and ruling party." Senior spokesperson Choi Bo-yoon told reporters that day, "Given that the early voting rates in Daegu (18.65%) and North Gyeongsang Province (22.42%) were not high, we see that judgment against the Democratic Party and the Lee Jae-myung regime is taking place," adding, "If there were a strong judgment against the People Power Party in battlegrounds like Seoul and the Chungcheong region, the early voting rate should have been high, but that trend did not emerge." (국민의힘은 유권자들이 ‘오만한 정부·여당 심판론’에 호응한 결과라고 했다. 최보윤 수석대변인은 이날 기자들과 만나 “대구(18.65%)·경북(22.42%) 사전투표율이 높지 않았다는 점에서 민주당과 이재명 정권에 대한 심판이 이뤄지고 있다고 보고 있다”며 “서울과 충청권 등 격전지에서 국민의힘에 대한 심판론이 높다면 사전투표율이 높게 나왔어야 했는데 그런 흐름이 아니었다”고 말했다.)

Rep. Jang Dong-hyuk also said at a press briefing, "The early voting rate has risen, and I think the main election turnout should also increase so that the people's anger judging the arrogance of Lee Jae-myung and the Democratic Party translates into votes." Election committee chief Jeong Hee-yong said in a statement on the 30th, "The high early voting rate is a strong warning from the people against arrogant power that disregards public opinion," adding, "Citizens angered by attempts to cancel trials to erase the president's crimes, citizens frustrated by the fading dream of owning a home, and citizens and provincial residents who felt they could not entrust their regions to unqualified and unverified candidates headed to the polls." (장동혁 대표도 기자 간담회에서 “사전투표율 높아졌는데 본투표 투표율도 높아져서 이재명과 민주당의 오만함을 심판하는 국민의 분노가 표로 이어져야 된다고 생각한다”고 말했다. 정희용 선거대책본부장은 지난 30일 입장문에서 “높은 사전투표율은 국민 눈치 보지 않는 오만한 권력을 향한 국민의 강력한 경고”라며 “대통령의 죄를 지우기 위한 재판 취소 시도에 분노한 국민, 멀어져 가는 내 집 마련 꿈에 좌절한 국민, 자격도 능력도 검증되지 않은 후보들에게 지역을 맡길 수 없다고 생각한 시민과 도민들께서 투표장으로 향했다”고 말했다.)

However, both inside and outside the political world believe that the record-high early voting rate will not necessarily lead directly to a record-high final turnout. (다만 정치권 안팎에서는 역대 최고 사전투표율이 곧바로 역대 최고 최종 투표율로 이어지지는 않을 거라고 보고 있다.)

Park Sung-min, head of the political consulting firm "Min," told The Hankyoreh, "Since the introduction of early voting in 2014, the early voting rate has been steadily increasing. As the early voting system becomes established, the total number of votes is being spread out," adding, "It's simply a matter of the voting period being divided into three days." Rep. Jeong Cheong-rae also said at the Hadong rally, "There is also a perspective that because voters tend to 'handle other errands on main election day,' the early voting rate has naturally increased. I agree with that perspective as well." (박성민 ‘정치컨설팅 민’ 대표는 한겨레에 “2014년 사전투표 도입 이후 사전투표율은 계속 늘어나고 있다. 사전투표제가 정착됨에 따라 전체 투표수가 분산되고 있는 것”이라며 “단순히 투표일이 3일로 나뉜 거라 보면 된다”고 했다. 정청래 대표도 하동 유세에서 “‘본투표일에 다른 볼일 보자’라는 (유권자) 경향성이 있어서 사전투표가 자연스레 높아졌다는 관점도 있다. 이런 관점에도 동의한다”고 말했다.)

Reporters Kim Chae-woon and Yoo Young-jae cwk@hani.co.kr (김채운 유영재 기자 cwk@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Kim Boo-kyum’s ‘Wall-Knocking’ Campaign…Choo Kyung-ho Appears with Park Geun-hye (김부겸, ‘벽치기 유세’…추경호는 박근혜 함께)
item.description:
On the 31st, three days before the main vote in the June 3 local elections, Kim Boo-kyum, the Democratic Party candidate for Daegu mayor—considered the biggest battleground—and Choo Kyung-ho, the People Power Party candidate, toured Daegu to rally support. Kim deployed his signature ‘wall-knocking’ campaign as a final gambit, while Choo, following a similar move on the 23rd, once again visited a market with former President Park Geun-hye to consolidate conservative support. (6·3 지방선거 최대 격전지로 꼽히는 대구시장 선거에 나선 김부겸 더불어민주당 후보와 추경호 국민의힘 후보가 본투표 사흘 전인 31일 대구 곳곳을 돌며 지지를 호소했다. 김 후보는 자신의 ‘상징’인 이른바 벽치기 유세로 막판 승부수를 띄웠고, 추 후보는 지난 23일에 이어 또 한번 박근혜 전 대통령과 시장을 찾아 보수층 결집을 노렸다.)

That day, Kim began his first campaign stop at the dawn market in Dalseong Park, Jung-gu. He then conducted a wall-knocking campaign at apartment complexes in Bongmu-dong, Dong-gu. The term ‘wall-knocking campaign’ originated from Kim’s practice in Daegu, where crowds are sparse at rally sites, of canvassing every corner of apartment complexes and alleys and delivering speeches as if talking to a wall. At Kim’s campaign site that day, Kang Hyo-sang, honorary election committee chairperson and former Saenuri Party lawmaker who recently joined Kim’s camp, accompanied him, stating, “(Kim) is the only hope to revive Daegu.” Regarding the early voting on the 29th and 30th, where Daegu recorded a turnout of 18.65%, up from 14.80% four years ago, Kim’s joint election committee chairperson, Kwon Chil-seung, said, “This is the result of a collective desire for Daegu, which has been stagnant, to seize new opportunities for change and development through Kim.” <<> Choo also began his day at the dawn market in Dalseong Park. In the afternoon, he visited Seomun Market in Jung-gu with former President Park. During his campaign, Choo said, “Those who said they’d vote on the main day because they’re worried about early voting must come out to the polls,” urging his supporters to show their backing. <<> Former President Park, appearing in a black blouse and jeans, said, “Seomun Market is a symbolic place for conservatism,” and added, “Seeing you all, even though I’m a bit tired, I feel my energy renewed.” She continued, “I know well that these days, Daegu’s economy is struggling and you’re all going through a lot,” and remarked, “I believe our candidate Choo Kyung-ho will revive Daegu’s economy and repay you.” <<> By Choi Ha-yan chy@hani.co.kr and Kim Hae-jeong sea@hani.co.kr (이날 김 후보는 대구 중구 달성공원 새벽시장에서 첫 유세를 시작했다. 동구 봉무동 아파트단지 등에선 벽치기 유세에 나섰다. 벽치기 유세는 김 후보가 유세장에 사람이 잘 모이지 않는 대구에서 아파트단지나 골목 구석구석을 훑으며 마치 벽을 보고 이야기하듯 연설한 것을 두고 생긴 표현이다. 이날 김 후보의 유세 현장에는 최근 김 후보 캠프에 합류한 강효상 명예선거대책위원장(전 새누리당 의원)이 동행해 “(김 후보가) 대구를 살리는 유일한 희망”이라고 말했다. 김 후보 캠프의 권칠승 공동선대위원장은 지난 29~30일 사전투표에서 대구가 4년 전(14.80%)보다 높은 투표율(18.65%)을 기록한 것에 대해서는 “김 후보를 통해 그동안 침체된 대구가 새로운 변화와 발전의 계기를 마련하기를 바라는 마음이 뭉쳐진 결과”라고 했다.)

item.title: “Why is Ha Jung-woo trying to fight ordinary citizens?”…“A Han Dong-hoon supporter assaulted a resident” (“하정우, 왜 일반시민과 싸우려하나”…“한동훈 지지자가 주민 폭행”)
item.description:
On May 31, three days before the June 3 by-election for the Busan North Gap National Assembly seat, Ha Jung-woo, the Democratic Party of Korea candidate, and Han Dong-hoon, the People Power Party candidate, focused on meeting citizens as they toured various areas of Buk-gu. The negative campaigning between the two candidates has been intensifying daily. <<> Candidate Ha conducted a “Every Corner of Buk-gu” campaign tour on this final Sunday before the main vote, gauging grassroots sentiment. In the afternoon, he greeted people on the streets in Deokcheon-dong. During the rally, Ha appealed for support, saying, “Isn’t Buk-gu my hometown? This hometown, which had fallen behind in development—if we develop it over four years and achieve great results, wouldn’t those results become a stepping stone for all of Busan, the Busan-Ulsan-Gyeongnam region, and our country?” <<> Candidate Han visited Gupo-dong, Deokcheon-dong, and Manduk-dong that day, meeting residents, and held a rally in front of Sukdeung Station in the afternoon. Han said, “Since former President Kim Young-sam in 1992, there has been no politician in Busan who truly captured the justice and fervent passion of the citizens. I will inherit former President Kim’s spirit and boldness. Thus, I will reawaken Busan’s politics and open a new future for South Korea.” Park Min-shik, a People Power Party candidate, sought to consolidate conservative supporters by participating in a schedule with former President Lee Myung-bak, who visited Busan. <<> As the main voting day approaches, the verbal sparring between Ha and Han, who are in a tight race within the margin of error in recent polls, continues. On May 30, Han posted a video on Facebook titled “Difference in Attitude Toward the Public.” In the video, Ha is seen saying to a man, “Again, again, again, again, again. You need to give me time to explain, don’t you? Time.” The man appears to be a YouTuber supporting Han, who had been following Ha, repeatedly demanding an explanation regarding the disposal of shares in Ha’s AI startup Upstage. Ha responded to this. Han criticized Ha over this, saying, “Why are you trying to fight ordinary citizens when you’re too scared to fight me and run away?” <<> In response, Ha also fired back by posting on Facebook a piece titled “Buk-gu Resident Assault Incident, Candidate Han Dong-hoon, Answer This.” After posting a video showing the man from Han’s video seemingly shoving another citizen, Ha retaliated, saying, “Manage your fan club thoroughly first.” <<> By Yoo Young-jae, Reporter young@hani.co.kr (6·3 부산 북갑 국회의원 보궐선거를 사흘 앞둔 31일, 하정우 더불어민주당 후보와 한동훈 국민의힘 후보는 북구 곳곳을 돌며 시민들을 만나는 데 집중했다. 두 후보 간 네거티브도 연일 과열되고 있다.)
